IntrinsicBodyRequest.description: One immutable first-party ordinal source supplies a single intrinsic Body field. Arrays and ordered object members, including duplicates, retain source order. Object keys are inline UTF-8 bytes. Source identity and field identity remain fixed through terminal output or explicit close; original source backing is never a cursor allocation.

Grant.description: One advance moves at most one structural event or one physical symbol-page birth and visits/copies at most 64 logical bytes. Text comparisons charge both input spans. Output storage belongs to the caller. Close uses independent whole physical release grants. Zero item or insufficient copy/capacity/release grants leave the corresponding ownership event inert.
